title: How much do Americans spend on streaming? (Q3 2025)

facts.fact: Reviews.org research estimates the average American household spends approximately $52 per month on streaming subscriptions.
facts.quote: The average American household now spends approximately $52 per month on streaming subscriptions, totaling around $620 annually

facts.fact: The page reports an 18% year-over-year increase in streaming spending from 2024 to 2025.
facts.quote: This represents an 18% increase from 2024, when the average was $42.38 per month

facts.fact: According to The Wrap, the average American household spent $42.38 per month on streaming in 2024.
facts.quote: when the average was $42.38 per month according to

facts.fact: According to The Wrap, average monthly streaming spending fell 23% from 2023 to 2024.
Reviews.org reports an average of 2.68 streaming services per household in 2025.
facts.quote: Average subscriptions (2025): 2.68 services per household, up from 2.2 in 2024

facts.fact: According to American Business Times, the average number of streaming subscriptions per household was 2.2 in 2024.
According to MediaPost, nearly 25% of U.S. households spend over $100 monthly on streaming and subscription services.
facts.quote: Nearly 25% of U.S. households spend over $100 monthly on streaming and subscription services

facts.fact: Bango/3Gem research reports an average of 5.4 subscriptions per household, with 2 of them bundled.
Parks Associates reports nearly 6 video services on average, with $109 monthly spend.
facts.quote: Parks Associates: Nearly 6 video services on average, $109 monthly

facts.fact: Kantar reports an average of 4.1 paid streaming services per household.
Bango research segments moderate streamers as spending $40-$80 per month, typically on 2-4 services.
Bango research segments light streamers as spending under $30 per month.
facts.quote: Light streamers: Under $30/month, often using one primary service plus free options

facts.fact: American Business Times reports the average U.S. cable TV bill at $101 per month in 2025, up 14% from 2024.
American Business Times reports average internet service costs of $68 per month.
Cable Papa states cable premium packages cost $147 or more per month, including sports and equipment fees.
facts.quote: Cable premium packages: $147+ including sports and equipment fees

facts.fact: According to Tom's Guide, Netflix Premium costs $24.99 per month (4K, extra members) in 2025.
According to Tom's Guide, Max Ultimate costs $20.99 per month (4K, ad-free) in 2025.
According to Tom's Guide, Disney+ Premium costs $15.99 per month (ad-free) in 2025.
According to Tom's Guide, Netflix Standard with Ads costs $7.99 per month in 2025.
According to Tom's Guide, Max with Ads costs $9.99 per month and Disney+ Basic costs $9.99 per month in 2025.
According to Tom's Guide, Peacock Premium costs $7.99 per month with limited ads in 2025.
According to Tom's Guide, YouTube TV costs $82.99 per month with unlimited DVR in 2025.
According to Business Standard, over 50% of new Netflix sign-ups choose the ad-supported plan.
facts.quote: over 50% of new Netflix sign-ups now choose the ad-supported plan

facts.fact: The page states that 72% of U.S. households have cut the cord.
facts.quote: 72% of U.S. households have cut the cord
